blacklistabilityReview.evidence: Ethereum 0x9f4330700a36b29952869fac9b33f45eedd8a3d8 is 100% of tracked yBOLD circulation. At Ethereum block 26224667 (2026-10-19T05:55:35Z) its runtime was the 45-byte EIP-1167 minimal clone hard-coded to Yearn V3 Vault implementation 0xd8063123bba3b480569244ae66bfe72b6c84b00d, consistent with the earlier block-25712273 review whose EIP-1967 implementation/admin slots on clone and implementation were zero. asset() returned BOLD 0x6440f144b7e50d6a8439336510312d2f54beb01d, apiVersion() returned 3.0.4 and isShutdown() was false. Verified transfer/transferFrom paths have no blacklist, freeze, pause, seizure or allowlist, and shutdown/strategy debt roles do not restrict share transfers. However, set_withdraw_limit_module (WITHDRAW_LIMIT_MANAGER) can install an owner-sensitive limiter enforced during redemption via available_withdraw_limit(owner,max_loss,strategies). The nonzero role_manager 0xb3bd6b2e61753c311efbcf0111f75d29706d9a41 can assign this role; withdraw_limit_module() is currently zero. Thus the token has a dormant mutable holder-facing redemption surface: Possible, not an active Yes gate. Its declared BOLD parent is No; 100% of the curated reserve book is BOLD strategy positions with 0% qualifying issuer/custodian exposure, which does not supersede the direct Possible surface. Yearn documentation likewise describes unrestricted share transfers.

oracleRisk.summary: yBOLD is a tokenized Liquity V2 Stability Pool position with no borrower-owned collateral branches of its own; its underlying BOLD exposure inherits Liquity V2 collateral-feed validation, fallback, and branch shutdown behavior.

branchApplicability.reviewer: OpenAI Codex W1b oracle applicability review
branchApplicability.rationale: yBOLD values vault shares against BOLD deployed across Liquity V2 Stability Pools for deposits and redemptions, so its vault share exchange rate is a price-sensitive top-level authority. yBOLD holders do not open borrower positions, and the wrapper has no local collateral-market or liquidation branches to inventory.

oracleRisk.reviewer: Codex Safety Score V9 data research

bridgeRouteRisk.summary: yBOLD is tracked only as an Ethereum Yearn vault wrapper for BOLD. The reviewed Yearn docs do not expose a separate bridge route for the vault share, so the row is single-chain/native.
